title: Design Homepage Layout
description: Create wireframes and mockups for the upcoming homepage redesign, ensuring mobile responsiveness and brand consistency.
notes: Include dark mode support and ensure accessibility compliance. Consider feedback from the last design review.

title: Fix User Login Bug
description: Investigate and fix the intermittent login failure reported by 15% of users on mobile devices.
notes: Check OAuth token refresh logic and cross-device session handling. Reproduce bug on iOS Safari.

title: Update Privacy Policy
description: Revise the privacy policy to comply with the latest GDPR guidelines and new California data protection laws.
notes: Ensure the updated policy is reviewed by both the EU and California compliance teams before publishing.

title: Team Meeting Preparation
description: Prepare slides and key talking points for Monday's quarterly strategy meeting.
notes: Focus on Q3 performance and upcoming product launch plans. Keep presentation under 15 minutes.

title: Customer Feedback Analysis
description: Analyze recent feedback from the online survey to identify areas of improvement in the product UI.
notes: Look for common complaints in navigation flow and loading speed. Highlight top 5 improvement suggestions.

title: Marketing Email Campaign
description: Draft and schedule the next promotional email blast to target segment B of user base.
notes: Use A/B testing for subject lines and include a limited-time offer to boost engagement.

title: Inventory Check
description: Audit current inventory levels and prepare reorder requests for low-stock items.
notes: Pay attention to high-demand items and coordinate with suppliers for faster delivery.

title: Onboard New Interns
description: Set up accounts, assign mentors, and provide orientation material for the three new interns joining next week.
notes: Ensure all interns have laptops, access credentials, and training schedules ready.

title: Update API Documentation
description: Write updated API documentation for the new endpoints and include code examples.
notes: Include request/response examples and authentication notes for each endpoint.

title: Office Renovation Planning
description: Meet with contractors to discuss layout changes and furniture options for the office renovation.
notes: Get at least 3 different quotations and focus on ergonomic furniture options.
